text:
mia: Quick question — p95 on the endpoint breakdown for /v1/generate is ~120ms but the overall endpoint p95 shows 60ms. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/latency?endpoint=/v1/generate :confused: Anyone know why?

sam: Did you include retries? the endpoint-level view excludes retries, but the route rollup includes them sometimes.

mia: I'm pretty sure retries are excluded in both. Query I used: ```SELECT approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) FROM traces WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND sampling_source='raw' GROUP BY endpoint```

jun: The dashboard's 'endpoint breakdown' uses tdigest rollup from rollup_v2 which merges weighted samples. If your time window has low sample counts it's noisy. What's the sample_count for that slice?

mia: sample_count for that slice = 34. Hmm low.

olivia: With n<100, tdigest percentiles can jump. Also check if the breakdown filters to p50/p95 by client_tag; the overall p95 aggregates across all clients and smooths with decaying window.

trent: Also check routing policy — canary traffic may be hitting a slow variant but overall weight is low so overall p95 is unaffected.

sam: Run this quick check: ```SELECT count(*) as n, approx_percentile(latency_ms, ARRAY[0.5,0.95,0.99]) FROM traces WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND time BETWEEN '2025-03-10T10:00:00Z' AND '2025-03-10T10:05:00Z' GROUP BY model_variant, client_tag```

mia: ran it, saw model_variant=gen-7b-slow had p95=300ms but n=3, variant weight 0.01 in routing.

natalie: Suggestion: In console we should show sample_count badge next to each percentile and grey-out if n<50. Filing UX ticket.

mia: @natalie please file? Also can we add an annotation on the chart when rollup source=tdigest? :eyes: 

natalie: filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/987 — proposed sample-badge + tdigest-hint

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for console-ui@v2.3.1 (rollout: 10%)

mia: Great, thanks everyone. I'll add slice to monitoring and pin the route.
